messages:
claudia: heads-up: ops telemetry shows a spike in fncall validation errors for product-search adapter on strict-validate route.
raj: saw it. reject_count up but invoke_count still normal. smells like JSONPath matched the wrong sibling.
kevin: can you paste a minimal payload + failing rule?
claudia: trace: https://traces/redwood/psi999
```json
{ "query": "desk chairs", "tool_res": { "items": [] }, "items": [] }
```
kevin: rule `$.items[*]` is ambiguous here and matches top-level items before tool_res.items; validator flags invalid_shape though invoke succeeded.
tori: consequence: reject metrics inflate and chargeback dashboards see noisy rejects while billing shows invokes -> confusion for finance.
raj: short-term: mute alert for that rule for 30m and deploy hotfix to prefer explicit fncall namespaces (e.g., fncall.tool) when present.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary rollout for validator v2 -> canary-2
lucas: console change: please add `matched_jsonpath` and a 50-char payload preview to validation events so triage doesn't require digging into traces.
kevin: also add a sampled flag `parse_shadowing=true` (10%) to ambiguous hits so we collect matched_jsonpath + payload snippet in logs for backfill.
raj: opening PR with hotfix + telemetry flag + CI linter to warn on ambiguous top-level JSONPaths.
tori: runbook updates: add step to check billing delta grouped by route_tag=strict-validate; mute rule if delta > 0.5%.
claudia: filing frontend ticket for console column and runbook note. will follow up in postmortem. thanks everyone.
